title: Red Teaming Large Reasoning Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It focused on the trustworthiness of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) across three dimensions: truthfulness, safety, and efficiency, primarily in mathematical, logical, and general reasoning tasks.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as these topics were outside the scope of its evaluation.
